kept.desc: Assertions for sourceRef, sourceCommit, and workingTreeFingerprint moved from main test to conditional test, reducing coverage in shallow clones where baseline commit is unreachable.
const permissions = await loadPermissionsForUser(...) result is accessed for .permissions property without null check; could throw TypeError if the function returns null/undefined
PostHog client error in .catch(() => {}) is silently swallowed with no logging or error recovery
Response from /api/crm/parties is cast to a type without validating structure; if server returns missing 'party' field, accessing payload.party.id throws TypeError.
Network error from loadParties() silently swallowed without logging, making debugging difficult
Errors in DNI/RUC lookup and party creation silently converted to generic 'failed' message without logging
created.party is accessed without null check; malformed API response will crash when accessing .id on undefined
Empty catch block silently swallows layout loading errors without logging or notification
Error from server.onSelectAllMatching() is silently swallowed, potentially masking network failures or permission errors without any indication to the user.
